questions.question:
If the volume of a sphere is 4851 cm³, then its surface area (in cm²) is∶

(Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of Sphere = 4851 cm³

⇒ r³ = 4851 × 3/4 × 7/22 = 441 × 21/8 = (21/2)³ ⇒ r = 10.5 cm

Surface Area = 4 π r² = 4 × 22/7 × 10.5 × 10.5

Surface Area = 88/7 × 110.25 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume (V) = 4851 cm³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × π × r³

Surface area of sphere = 4 × π × r²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c79d7d32bfb8bdd7e41748b8a94b821b8a036de8d29cf67d247f6b07bf4d5fc4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (4/3) × (22/7) × r³ = 4851

⇒ r³ = (4851 × 3 × 7) ÷ (4 × 22)

⇒ r³ = (441 × 21) ÷ 8

⇒ r³ = (21 × 21 × 21) ÷ (2 × 2 × 2)

⇒ r = 21/2 = 10.5 cm

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × (21/2) × (21/2)

⇒ Surface Area = (4 × 22 × 21 × 21) ÷ (7 × 2 × 2)

⇒ Surface Area = (88 × 441) ÷ 28

⇒ Surface Area = 22 × 63 = 1386 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1386 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere and Hemisphere

For a sphere of radius r: Volume = (4/3)πr³ and Curved Surface Area = Total Surface Area = 4πr².

Hemisphere Formulas

For a hemisphere: Volume = (2/3)πr³, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Ratio of Volume to Surface Area

For a sphere, the ratio of Volume to Surface Area is r/3.</p

questions.question: The radius and height of a cylinder are in the ratio 4 : 7 and its volume is 2816 cm³. Find its radius. (Take π = frac {22} 7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Radius (r) : Height (h) = 4 : 7

Let r = 4x and h = 7x

Volume = πr²h = (22/7) × (4x)² × 7x = 2816

22 × 16x² × x = 2816 ⇒ 352x³ = 2816

x³ = 8 ⇒ x = 2

Radius = 4 × 2 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of radius to height (r : h) = 4 : 7

Volume of the cylinder = 2816 cm³

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c13d4b6b54e073b780bc6df2b565026b3f10faf96ac11381170e885d4ab55210.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the radius be 4x and the height be 7x.

⇒ Volume = π × (4x)² × (7x)

⇒ 2816 = (22/7) × 16x² × 7x

⇒ 2816 = 22 × 16x² × x

⇒ 2816 = 352x³

⇒ x³ = 2816 ÷ 352

⇒ x³ = 8

⇒ x = ³√8 = 2

⇒ Radius (r) = 4x = 4 × 2 = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder

The area of the curved surface is given by the formula 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The sum of the area of the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Relation with Cone

The volume of a cylinder is three times the volume of a cone with the same radius and height: VolumeCyₗᵢₙdₑᵣ = 3 × VolumeCₒₙₑ.</p

questions.question: The lateral surface area of a cylinder is 352 cm². If its height is 7 cm, then its volume (in cm) is ∶ Take π=22/7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LSA = 2πrh = 352 cm² and h = 7 cm.

Radius (r) = LSA ÷ (2 × π × h) = 352 ÷ (2 × 22/7 × 7) = 352 ÷ 44 = 8 cm.

Volume = πr²h = (LSA × r) ÷ 2 = (352 × 8) ÷ 2 = 176 × 8.

Volume = 1408 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1408 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Lateral Surface Area (LSA) of cylinder = 352 cm²

Height (h) = 7 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula:**

Lateral Surface Area = 2πrh

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cba71e82ecef4f1becabbe83b6bdd25755b536919294f1c48ff5737e0951a763.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r × 7 = 352

⇒ 44 × r = 352

⇒ r = 352 ÷ 44

⇒ r = 8 cm

⇒ Volume = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 8 × 8 × 7

⇒ Volume = 22 × 64

⇒ Volume = 1408 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1408 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

The total surface area includes the lateral area and the area of two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(r + h).

Volume of Cone

A cone with the same radius and height as a cylinder has exactly one-third its volume: Volume = (1/3)πr²h.

Base Area of Cylinder

The area of the circular base or top is given by the formula: Area = πr².</p

questions.question: The internal diameter of a hollow hemispherical vessel is 24 cm. It is made of a steel sheet which is 0.5 cm thick. What is the total surface area (in cm²) of the vessel?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Inner radius (r) = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm; Outer radius (R) = 12 + 0.5 = 12.5 cm.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of hollow hemisphere = 3πR² + πr².

TSA = 3π(12.5)² + π(12)².

TSA = 3π × 156.25 + 144π = 468.75π + 144π = 612.75π.

**∴ The correct answer is 612.75π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Internal diameter = 24 cm ⇒ Internal radius (r) = 12 cm.

Thickness (t) = 0.5 cm ⇒ External radius (R) = 12 + 0.5 = 12.5 cm.

Formula used: TSA of hollow hemisphere = Outer CSA + Inner CSA + Area of the ring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/483181e5ea02e4c67a5e382d8a7aceaed8368b5f57b3f4a59268b7d3395e757b.png] 

Calculations:

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2πR² + 2πr² + π(R² − r²)

⇒ Total Surface Area = π[2R² + 2r² + R² − r²]

⇒ Total Surface Area = π[3R² + r²]

⇒ Total Surface Area = π[3 × (12.5)² + (12)²]

⇒ Total Surface Area = π[3 × 156.25 + 144]

⇒ Total Surface Area = π[468.75 + 144]

⇒ Total Surface Area = 612.75π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 612.75π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Solid Hemisphere

For a solid hemisphere, the TSA includes the curved surface and the flat base: TSA = 3πr².

Volume of Hollow Hemisphere

The amount of material or capacity of a hollow hemispherical shell: Volume = (2/3)π(R³ − r³).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

For any hemisphere, the area of the curved part only is CSA = 2πr².</p

questions.question:
The volume of a hemisphere is 2425 frac 1 2 cm³. Find its radius.

(Take π = frac {22} 7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

Convert mixed fraction: 2425 1/2 = 4851/2 cm³

4851/2 = (2/3) × (22/7) × r³

r³ = (4851 × 21) / (2 × 44) = (441 × 21) / 8 = 21³ / 2³

r = 21/2 = 10.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of hemisphere (V) = 2425 1/2 cm³ = 4851/2 cm³

Value of π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3df53595c1a06fe62f7b780768bdd35d7019e2b85d02698d5ccf82eef9681bad.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4851/2 = (2/3) × (22/7) × r³

⇒ 4851/2 = (44/21) × r³

⇒ r³ = (4851 × 21) / (2 × 44)

⇒ r³ = (441 × 11 × 21) / (2 × 4 × 11)

⇒ r³ = (21² × 21) / 8

⇒ r³ = 9261 / 8

⇒ r = ³√(9261 / 8)

⇒ r = 21 / 2

⇒ r = 10.5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 10.5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere

The area of the curved part of a hemisphere is 2πr².

Total Surface Area of Hemisphere

The total surface area (including the flat circular base) is 3πr².

Volume of a Sphere

A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere. Volume of a full sphere is (4/3)πr³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a full sphere is 4πr².</p

questions.question: If the curved surface area of a solid cylinder is one-third of its total surface area, then what is the ratio of its diameter to its height?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: CSA / TSA = 1 / 3

Ratio of Height to (Height + Radius) ⇒ h / (h + r) = 1 / 3

Cross-multiplying: 3h = h + r ⇒ r = 2h

Diameter (d) = 2r = 2 × (2h) = 4h

Ratio of Diameter to Height = d : h = 4h : h = 4 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = (1/3) × Total Surface Area (TSA)

Formula for CSA = 2πrh

Formula for TSA = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fa961bf797100b0fca724bed7cb9baaf7d3cc1207bdcb1c32fbca0b309a58f2.png] 

According to the question:

⇒ 2πrh = (1/3) × 2πr(h + r)

⇒ h = (1/3) × (h + r)

⇒ 3h = h + r

⇒ r = 3h − h

⇒ r = 2h

We need to find the ratio of diameter (d) to height (h):

⇒ d = 2r

⇒ d = 2 × (2h) = 4h

⇒ d/h = 4/1

⇒ d : h = 4 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a solid cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Surface Areas of Cone

CSA of a cone = πrl and TSA of a cone = πr(l + r), where l is the slant height (√(r² + h²)).

Surface Area of Sphere

For a sphere, the CSA and TSA are the same, given by 4πr².</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is 594 cm² and its volume is 1336.5 cm³. What is the height (in cm) of the cylinder?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Volume (V) to Curved Surface Area (CSA) for a cylinder is always r/2.

r/2 = V ÷ CSA = 1336.5 ÷ 594 = 2.25

Radius (r) = 2.25 × 2 = 4.5 cm

Now, CSA = 2πrh ⇒ 594 = 2 × (22/7) × 4.5 × h

h = (594 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22 × 4.5) = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 594 cm²

Volume (V) = 1336.5 cm³

Formula Used: CSA = 2πrh and Volume = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ab4a83466efd33138298dcc85081611732a0beb6838675bbc23ac73b80c3c3.png] 

Dividing Volume by CSA:

⇒ (πr²h) ÷ (2πrh) = 1336.5 ÷ 594

⇒ r / 2 = 2.25

⇒ r = 2.25 × 2 = 4.5 cm

Substitute the value of r in the CSA formula:

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 4.5 × h = 594

⇒ (44/7) × (9/2) × h = 594

⇒ (198/7) × h = 594

⇒ h = (594 × 7) ÷ 198

⇒ h = 3 × 7

⇒ h = 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(r + h).

Relationship between V, CSA, and Radius

For any cylinder, the radius r can be directly found if Volume (V) and CSA are known: r = 2V ÷ CSA.

Volume of a Hollow Cylinder

If R is the outer radius and r is the inner radius, Volume = π(R² − r²)h.</p

questions.question: The radius of the base of a right circular cylinder is 3 cm and its curved surface are is 60 πcm². The volume of the cylinder (in cm³) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct relation between Volume (V), Curved Surface Area (CSA), and Radius (r):

Volume (V) = (CSA × r) ÷ 2

Given: CSA = 60π cm² and r = 3 cm

V = (60π × 3) ÷ 2 = 180π ÷ 2 = 90π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 90π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Radius (r) = 3 cm, Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 60π cm²

Formula used: Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh | Volume (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7466b1359af6d9d98013716db2d03024941940489b637c2a840b992bd185e2bc.png] 

⇒ 2 × π × r × h = 60π

⇒ 2 × 3 × h = 60

⇒ 6h = 60

⇒ h = 10 cm

⇒ Volume = π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = π × 3² × 10

⇒ Volume = π × 9 × 10

⇒ Volume = 90π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 90π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular ends: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Base Area of a Cylinder

The area of the base (or top) of a right circular cylinder is the area of a circle: Area = πr².

Relationship between CSA and Volume

Since CSA = 2πrh and V = πr²h, the Volume can be written as V = (CSA × r) ÷ 2. This is useful when the height is not directly required.</p

questions.question:
The circumference of the base of a cylindrical vessel is 158.4 cm and its height is 1 m. How many litres of water can it hold (correct to one decimal place)?

(Take pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Calculate radius directly from circumference: r = Circumference ÷ (2 × π) = 158.4 ÷ 6.2857 ≈ 25.2 cm.

Volume in cm³ = πr²h = (22/7) × (25.2)² × 100.

Convert to litres (1 litre = 1000 cm³): Volume = [22/7 × 635.04 × 100] ÷ 1000.

Volume = 199584 ÷ 1000 = 199.584 litres.

Rounding to one decimal place, we get 199.6 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 199.6 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Circumference of base = 158.4 cm

Height (h) = 1 m = 100 cm

π = 22/7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee47ead52d024332e314aedbb91afce2a6d5fb42d513c73414c2e8fa3d73f6ef.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Circumference = 2 × π × r

Volume of Cylinder = π × r² × h

1 Litre = 1000 cm³

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 158.4

⇒ r = (158.4 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22)

⇒ r = (158.4 × 7) ÷ 44

⇒ r = 3.6 × 7 = 25.2 cm

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (25.2)² × 100

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 25.2 × 25.2 × 100

⇒ Volume = 22 × 3.6 × 25.2 × 100

⇒ Volume = 79.2 × 2520 = 199584 cm³

⇒ Capacity in Litres = 199584 ÷ 1000

⇒ Capacity = 199.584 litres ≈ 199.6 litres

**∴ The correct answer is 199.6 litres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder

The area of the side surface is given by CSA = 2 × π × r × h.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder

The area of all surfaces including top and bottom: TSA = 2 × π × r × (r + h).

Volume and Capacity Units

1 m³ = 1000 litres; 1 litre = 1000 cm³; 1 cm³ = 1 ml.</p

questions.question: The radii of two cylinders are in the ratio 2 : 3 and their heights are in the ratio 5 : 3. The ratio of their volumes is
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cylinder is proportional to (Radius)² × Height.

Ratio of volumes = (Ratio of radii)² × (Ratio of heights)

Ratio of volumes = (2/3)² × (5/3) = (4/9) × (5/3)

Ratio of volumes = 20 : 27

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 27.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Ratio of radii (r₁ : r₂) = 2 : 3

Ratio of heights (h₁ : h₂) = 5 : 3

Formula used: Volume of cylinder (V) = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e78ae715f769ec7c1d3ec71e172201e4c4b59bc030e2369fcfd8884cee90c5ee.png] 

⇒ Let radii be 2r and 3r, and heights be 5h and 3h.

⇒ Volume of first cylinder (V₁) = π × (2r)² × 5h = 20πr²h

⇒ Volume of second cylinder (V₂) = π × (3r)² × 3h = 27πr²h

⇒ Ratio V₁ : V₂ = 20πr²h : 27πr²h

⇒ Ratio = 20 : 27

**∴ The correct answer is 20 : 27.**

**__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

The area of the curved surface is given by the formula CSA = 2πrh, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of a Cone

If a cone has the same radius and height as a cylinder, its volume is exactly one-third of the cylinder: Volume = (1/3)πr²h.</p
